# Usage errors, missing tasks, and forbidden operations fail with useful errors.
! exec tuck$exe check
stdout 'missing tasks directory'

exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe show --help
stdout 'Show a task'
! stderr .+

exitcode 2 list --unknown-option
stderr 'tuck list: unknown option "--unknown-option"'
! stdout .+

! exec tuck$exe add 'Invalid state' --state someday
stderr 'tuck add: invalid state "someday"'

exitcode 1 show 999
stderr 'tuck show: task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe start 999
stderr 'tuck start: task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe done 999
stderr 'tuck done: task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe reopen 999
stderr 'tuck reopen: task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe move 999 todo
stderr 'tuck move: task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe rename 999 'Missing task'
stderr 'tuck rename: task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe reorder 999 --first
stderr 'tuck reorder: task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe meta get 999
stderr 'tuck meta: task 999 not found'

exec tuck$exe add 'Completed item' --state todo
exec tuck$exe done 001
! exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --first
stderr 'done tasks keep completion order and cannot be reordered'

exec tuck$exe add 'Active item' --state todo
! exec tuck$exe reopen 002
stderr 'cannot reopen 002 from todo'

! exec tuck$exe meta set 001 id '"custom"'
stderr 'reserved'
